label: MICRA limit on noneconomic damages, wrongful death - starting amount
applies: Noneconomic losses in a wrongful death action against a health care provider based on professional negligence
movesWhen: Increases by $50,000 each 1 January for 10 years, to a ceiling of $1,000,000
note: The starting amount from 1 January 2023, on a separate and more generous schedule than the injury limit. Counting the stated increases gives $650,000 for 2026, which is arithmetic from the schedule rather than a printed figure.
author: Aaron Bollinger
